summary.text: Chris Hurt is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 82 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Chris Hurt assumed office representing Tennessee House District 82 on November 6, 2018.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education Administration and State Government committees.
